select r.source_support_type as businessAttributesId,(case r.source_support_type when 1 then '市场一部（郑哲）' when 2 then '市场二部（曹刘强）' when 3 then '互助' when 4 then '正言金融（郑哲）' when 5 then '市场三部（韩正栋）' end) as businessAttributesName,ifnull(count(1),0) as entrustCaseNum from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
group by r.source_support_type

select s.department_name as sourceName,count(1) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case s on r.survey_id = s.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
and n.org_attr = #{orgAttr,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and r.entrust_org_id = #{entrustOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND date_format(s.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(s.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and find_in_set(r.entrust_org_id,#{entrustOrgIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
group by s.department_id
